mumbaifoodjunkie on February 6, 2025: "Living my dreams, one day at a time! 🥰🧿✨
Catch me on Celebrity Masterchef Episode 8 & 9 on Sony TV and Sony Liv OTT!! 📺😍🧿✨ 

Being a guest judge on Sony TV’s most prestigious show has been an experience of a lifetime—tasting incredible dishes, witnessing pure culinary passion, and sharing the screen space with legends 💯

None of this would have been possible without YOU GUYS!! My Junkie Fam!! —my amazing community that has supported me through every reel, every review, every bite. Your love, encouragement & belief in me means the world to me! Thank you for being part of this journey. ❤️

Here’s to chasing dreams, embracing new adventures, and always celebrating the love for food and travel 🥹🫶🏻

#MumbaiFoodJunkie  #Grateful #CelebrityMasterChef #SonyTV #SonyLIV #GuestJudge #TV #LiveTV #DreamComeTrue #Mumbai #FoodBlogger #ContentCreatorLife #MasterChef #MasterChefIndia".
